title: fix(components): a page:tabs item visibleWhen that faults withholds its tab (objectui#13286)
body:
Fixes #13286
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A `page:tabs` item `visibleWhen` that **faults** on evaluation now fails **closed**: the tab (header and panel) is withheld instead of drawn. Faults covered: a source over the CEL engine's AST bound (`[bounds] Exceeded maxAstNodes`), a type error, an unbound root, a missing function, a malformed source, and a declared value that cannot be evaluated at all.

- `PageTabsRenderer.isItemVisible` (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`) still makes ONE `evaluateCondition` call. It reads the fault off that call's `onFault` and overrides the evaluator's fail-soft `true`. It does not use `throwOnError`, which would evaluate a CEL envelope twice.
- An absent `visibleWhen` still means visible. A blank one (`''`, whitespace, an empty-`source` envelope, i.e. `hasDeclaredPredicate` false) still means "no gate". It is visible and diagnosed with `[blank]` as before.
- **Logged once:** the fault goes through the shared `reportUnresolvableVisibilityPredicate`, with the same dedupe `Set` keyed on (node type, key, source). It now passes the `'withholding'` gate kind, the reporter's fail-closed visibility copy, so the console line says the tab was WITHHELD. It no longer says "the gate did NOT bite".
- **Active tab:** a withheld active tab falls back to the first visible tab. This reuses the existing path a `false` predicate takes (the filtered `items` feeding `activeValue`), and pin (e) measures it.
- `content/docs/guide/metadata-diagnostics.md`: the paragraph that said every node gate in this family keeps its verdict now names the `page:tabs` item gate as the one that fails closed. Without that edit the sentence would be false after this change.

## Sites changed and sites left

| Site | Verdict on a fault | Done here |
|---|---|---|
| `page:tabs` item `visibleWhen` (`isItemVisible`) | was visible, now **hidden** | changed |
| `page:tabs` count-probe gates (`isGateOpen`) | visible | **left alone.** It mirrors the body's node gate so a badge counts what the body draws. Flipping it alone would make the badge disagree with the panel. |
| Node-level `visibleWhen` / `visible` / `visibleOn` in `SchemaRenderer` (`packages/react`) | visible (documented fail-soft) | **left alone.** It is outside this claim's file surface, and its docblock records flipping it as a shipped-behaviour change on a live surface. It is raised in the report as an open question. |
| `page:header` action `visible` / `disabled` | already hidden / disabled | nothing to do |
| `page:header` action `hidden` | not hidden | left: a header-action gate, not a page-component visibility predicate |
| Form field rules (`resolveFieldRuleState` / `evalFieldPredicate`), form sections and field-group tabs | documented table | not changed (ruling); pin (d) is the control |

## Tests

New `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-tabs-visible-when-fail-closed-13286.test.tsx`:
- (a) a throwing item predicate (bare string and CEL envelope) is not rendered; two renders with fresh schema objects log ONE warning;
- (b) CONTROL: valid `false` hides, `true` shows, absent shows, blank shows, and none of them is reported as withheld;
- (c) an over-budget CEL source (120 OR-ed terms) is withheld with a `[bounds]` reason, while the same shape at 4 terms evaluates and shows;
- (d) CONTROL: a form field whose `visibleWhen` faults is still drawn;
- (e) an active tab whose predicate starts faulting vanishes and the first visible panel shows.

Updated `page-tabs-visible-when-fault-warning.test.tsx`: its two cases asserted the old fail-open draw. They now assert the tab is withheld, and their report assertions are unchanged.

Runs, at head `c40f99849c`:
- the touched/new pins plus `page-tabs-visibility.test.tsx`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 20 passed (20)`;
- the family naming the touched files (34 files: every `page-tabs-*` / `pageTabs*` test, plus each test that names `containers.tsx`, across components, react, app-shell, plugin-grid, types, scripts and console): `Test Files 34 passed (34)`, `Tests 791 passed (791)`, on the first commit;
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the second program includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`): exit 0, after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build` exit 0.

The full `packages/components` directory, and the rest of `pnpm test`, are left to CI.

**Ablation:** restoring the fail-open return (`return declared && faulted ? false : verdict;` replaced by `return verdict;` through `ablation-replace.mjs`; the anchor count went 1 to 0) turned (a) x2, (c) and (e) RED (`Tests 4 failed | 2 passed (6)`). The controls (b) and (d) stayed green. The restore is proven by blob hash: HEAD blob `2067d62d9a2d` was mutated to `6e32bd0b1c7b` and restored to `2067d62d9a2d`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No `dist/` step applies: the test reaches `containers.tsx` through a relative source import (`import '../renderers'`).

**Gates** (exit codes): `check:phantom-deps` 0, `check:self-import` 0, `check:unreferenced-sources` 0, `check:doc-example-readers` 0, `check:handler-key-reads` 0, `check:side-effects-array` 0, `check:element-data-source-declaration` 0, `check:spec-symbols` 0, `check:action-forward-parity` 0, `check:designer-field-key-parity` 0, `check:icon-record-names` 0, `check:i18n-keys` 0, `check:i18n-drift` 0, `check:i18n-designer-parity` 0, `check:control-bytes` 0, `check:doc-types` 0, `check:new-line-citations` 0, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs` 0, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` 0, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 because it needs a whole-workspace build artifact (`no-artifact`), so it is NOT MEASURED here.

**Lint**, narrowed to the 3 changed source files with the package's own `eslint .` config: `--format json` counts 3 files and 0 errors. With `--no-inline-config` there is 1 error, at the existing `react-hooks/static-components` site whose inline disable that flag ignores; it is not on a changed line. Type-aware linting is not configured in `eslint.config.js` (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict in any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- The `'withholding'` copy names "a navigation entry". A tab strip is in-page navigation, so the sentence is true here. A surface-neutral wording would need an edit to `packages/react/src/utils/visibilityDiagnostic.ts`, which is outside this claim. Carrier: none.
